tasks.summary: 53 tasks in 7 phases: setup, foundational, US1+US2 MVP, US3, US4, US5, polish; page sections registered per story keep phases file-disjoint

approach: A SearchableConfigurable under Tools reads designers from the platform's editor providers and stores every choice in one application PersistentStateComponent. Turning a designer off makes its provider refuse files; canvas options reach open designers through a message-bus topic and an effective-value check that respects options a definition fixes. Designers declare their own settings and origin as data.
